description: Reads the Neblla developer guide by section, or the complete reference of one tool (tools/<name>). More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_llms

appId.description: An app's id: the guide cut to that app's modules

group.description: With section "access": only this group of the team

maxLength.description: Maximum length of `guide` to return in this chunk

offset.description: Character position to start reading from. 0 = start

role.description: With section "access": only this role of the app

section.description: Which part of the guide to read. Default "core". "index" = contents, "full" = everything, "access" (with appId) = what each role and group can use, "tools/<name>" = one tool's reference. Chapters: empezar (when to use neblla); core (the base contract); salas (rooms and matchmaking); servidor (server (fog and no-code)); identidad (identity and persistence); social (friends and inbox); comunidad (community); pagos (purchases); ia (built-in ai); mundo (the 3d engine); sonido (eco and sound in your apps); creator (the creation portal and the store); publicar (publishing and quotas); referencia (sdk reference); mcp (mcp server)

name: neblla_get_llms
title: Get llms
